notes.title: GOING FREE TO PLAY !!!
notes.content:
We are considering going free to play to build the player base more. Of course with free to play comes some form of monetization. Let me know what you guys think but look for it in a week or 2. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34982549/289725b01cdafb389531824315dacb2b72e96dbf.jpg[/img]

Join Discord to discuss and be a part of the community !

https://discord.gg/U6Yxk2F

P.S. Anyone that buys the game before F2P they will receive continuous rewards every season.

notes.title: New Patch with new Map :0
notes.content:
New space assets and level are done. This is the first part of the open world test the map is in play (not the huge open world map but a piece of it.) More features for hosting and finding matches, networking improvements and a few player options. Hope you guys like the new stuff please be sure to report bugs to the discord and thanks for playing. I look forward to expanding this game with more features every month and bringing open world co-op content soon.

https://discord.gg/U6Yxk2F

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34982549/7e0677618c3bddbd81fb931dba5d6dd2a3d5decf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Summer Patch Time :)
notes.content:
With this new update we are introducing the ability to play on whichever map you want. With or without Ai. Now it can be a match filled with just player kills if you would like. So challenge your friends and look for a new summer map coming soon before the steam summer sale is over. Also working on a few more server options like the ability to set game time and how many Ai will spawn. Also being able to change score limits and difficulty of Ai are in the works. Thank you to everyone for feedback!  Keep it coming so I can keep the updates coming ! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34982549/ec26d597276ca1fda451e92f3cdb89bb9728611a.png[/img]

Join the Discord 
https://discord.gg/mXtUQCs

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and Update!
notes.content:
Update to multiplayer and smoothing everything out for more players per server. Also, 2 new maps coming real soon ;) thanks for playing and keep in touch on the discord.

https://discord.gg/U6Yxk2F

notes.title: Thanks and Rewards!
notes.content:
Thank you to a great first day with the community! I see some things that need to change ASAP thanks to the feedback. Look forward to first comers getting nice in game rewards. The first big update will be soon and will include some single player things to do. Hopefully it will give everyone some practice while we build the player base.

So, thanks to everyone and welcome! 

Be sure to check the Discord for more information and to vote on which new features will be coming next. 

[url=https://discord.gg/U6Yxk2F]Abstract Discord[/url]
